title: A user with only user.account.edit can give themselves or anyone the TENANT_SUPER_ADMIN role
summary: Editing a user's role needs only the account-edit right, and the new role takes effect at once, so any account editor can make themselves a super admin.
steps: Log in as a user whose role has only user.account.edit.
Edit your own user (or another) and assign TENANT_SUPER_ADMIN.
expected: The assignment is refused unless the caller already holds that role (or a dedicated 'assign roles' right).
actual: The role is assigned and works immediately (proved live on the e2e stack).
where: Backend: user account update / role assignment service
verify: As an account-edit-only user, PUT the user with TENANT_SUPER_ADMIN: expect 403.
status_evidence: Found while re-checking the backend on release_1.1.0, 2026-11-26.

title: /dev/test/* and /api/cns/registration-info answer 200 to a user with no rights
summary: A user with no granted permissions can call the dev test endpoints and read the notification-service registration info.
steps: Log in as a role with no permissions.
expected: 401/403, or the endpoints do not exist outside the dev profile.
actual: 200 on the e2e stack (dev profile); not checked on a production profile.
where: Backend: dev test controllers, CNS registration controller
verify: Run with the prod profile and repeat the calls: expect 404/403.
status_evidence: Found while re-checking the backend on release_1.1.0, 2026-11-26.

title: A vendor bill with a negative tax rate or unit price is saved, then cannot be approved
summary: Create accepts negative taxRate and billUnitPrice; approval then fails with 400 on the workflow task and the bill stays Pending forever.
steps: POST a vendor bill with taxRate -5 (or billUnitPrice -1).
expected: The create is refused with a readable 400.
actual: 201 on create; 400 on approval; the bill is stuck Pending.
status_evidence: Found while re-checking the backend on release_1.1.0, 2026-11-26.

title: Two parallel bin transfers of 10 from a bin holding 10 both become Pending with only 10 reserved
summary: The reservation is not locked, so both transfers are accepted and approving both could move stock twice.
steps: Send two bin transfers of 10 from a bin holding exactly 10 at the same time.
expected: The second is refused (insufficient stock) or reserved separately.
where: Backend: bin transfer create and reservation
verify: Repeat the two parallel POSTs: one must be 4xx.
status_evidence: Found while re-checking the backend on release_1.1.0, 2026-11-26.
